card.name: Scale words before counted units
card.fires_on: The last digit of a power-of-ten exponent, or a scale word like billion or per, right before a counted unit such as vector genomes, hours, gallons, pixels or characters.

modes.label: Exponent digit in dose
modes.description: Final exponent digit in a gene-therapy dose written as 10 to a power, just before vector genomes.
modes.example: The recommended dose of OTARMENI for each ear is 7.2 × 10 1<<2>> vector genomes (vg) in a total

modes.label: Billion before a unit
modes.description: The word billion after a number, followed by a counted thing like hours, gallons or pixels.
modes.example: That’s a photograph containing 50<< billion>> pixels.

modes.label: Linking word before a unit
modes.description: A short word like per or of that comes right before a unit noun.
modes.example: A suggested limit for the number<< of>> characters in a TITLE is 60

card.writes: It pushes the model toward unit nouns like units, pixels and atoms as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on a big-number word or exponent when the thing being counted is about to be named.
